feedback: This candidate is the best raced design (iteration 4, score 120.36) with one geometry change: all five sensor rows move from y=0.05 to y=0.07 m. The x values and weights [-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1] are unchanged, and the y value is inside the allowed range. It keeps kd at 0.4 even though the iteration-4 rule said to return to 0.3 if bend oscillation did not fall. The Optimizer explains that kd 0.4 gave the best measured progress on all three tracks (oval 0.48, s-bend 0.26, slalom 0.125), so I accept that override for this race. The earlier evidence supports this lever: iteration 4 showed progress stuck near 0.15 to 0.26 on the bends while the gains changed, and it did not move the bend oscillation down (s-bend 0.139 to 0.202). This points to late reaction on bends as a geometric limit, not a gain limit. I am approving this race because it is a clean single-lever test on the best build, and the telemetry will show whether forward sensors help. Read the race as follows. If s-bend and slalom progress rises above the iteration-4 values (0.26 and 0.125) with oscillation at or below the iteration-4 level, keep y=0.07 and then test ki 0.3 with kd 0.4. If progress does not rise, the drift is more likely a fixed motor mismatch, so raise ki and keep the sensors at y=0.07. If oscillation rises sharply on the oval, lower kd back to 0.3 before any further geometry change.
requested_changes: After race 5: if s-bend and slalom progress rises above 0.26 and 0.125 with steering_oscillation at or below the iteration-4 values, keep geometry.sensor_positions at y=0.07 and test controller.ki at 0.3 with kd 0.4, since the drift may then be a fixed motor mismatch.

After race 5: if progress does not rise on the s-bend (still about 0.26 or lower), keep y=0.07 and raise controller.ki from 0.2 to 0.3 to cancel the fixed left/right mismatch, because the iteration-4 gain changes did not move progress.

After race 5: if steering_oscillation on the oval rises above the iteration-4 value of 0.283, lower controller.kd from 0.4 to 0.3 and keep y=0.07, because iteration 1 showed kd 0.3 reduced oval oscillation.
